pillar_b_first_principles_investigation.root_cause_summary: All three unmet sub-criteria (P13-H4 W2_raw 8/10 seeds >= 0.90; P13-H5 W2_raw CKA 0.745 < 0.85; P13-H7 W3_raw in-dist nRMSE >= 0.05 in 8/10 seeds) traced to a single first-principles root cause in unwhitened Euclidean Stiefel kurtosis minimization: (1) In W2_raw (seeds 22 & 27), the 3 binary nuisance factors have 7x the variance (sigma^2 = 4.0) and lower kurtosis (kappa = 1.00) than the 3-level property u (sigma^2 = 0.57, kappa = 1.65). A 36.8-degree Euclidean rotation allowed one binary nuisance factor to dominate TWO columns simultaneously (|Corr(Z_1, Z_2)| = 0.74), achieving a lower unweighted kurtosis sum (0.2957 < 0.2967) than the true unmixing matrix W*. (2) In W3_raw (seeds 28 & 29), 5 restarts x 80 steps stopped in a 45-degree planar saddle (A +/- B)/sqrt(2), which by the Polarization Identity A*B = ((A+B)^2 - (A-B)^2)/4 allowed univariate slot MLPs to fit the 5AB interaction in-distribution.
pillar_b_first_principles_investigation.first_principles_solution: Added a pairwise correlation non-duplication guard (penalizing |Corr(Z_i, Z_j)| > 0.52, above the maximum 0.50 missing-corner training correlation) with decayed step schedule (10 restarts x 100 steps) in OrthogonalUnmixingLayer.fit_subspace().
